readings.moment: When the family showed their watches, just after the temple struck nine; Félix's watch showed twenty minutes to nine
When the temple struck ten; the salon clock showed five minutes to ten
When Casimir went out to fetch his cigars
A moment after Casimir came back, the hall clock struck eleven

durations: thirty years (Casimir as the family's friend)
four years (Aurèle spent on the repeater)
whereabouts: Madame Monnier's husband made the family show their watches at the temple's nine o'clock strike.
Each family member took their watch out of their pocket when the temple struck nine.
Félix laughed when his watch was shown to be slow.
Monsieur Girard and Madame Monnier's husband quarrelled at the table about the price of the repeater.
Afterwards, Madame Monnier was in the salon.
Madame Monnier was in the salon when the temple struck ten.
Casimir and Madame Monnier sat down to piquet in the salon.
Casimir went out of the salon at 10:28 by the salon clock to fetch his cigars.
Madame Monnier sat down at the piano at once after Casimir went out.
Madame Monnier played the piano until Casimir came back, and stopped when he came in.
Casimir came back into the house before the hall clock struck eleven.
Madame Monnier was never allowed in the atelier.
